issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按默认 150f 渲染
镜头 3 的 2.2x 特写走 transform scale，对准的是两张卡之间的位置，字边靠合成层放大
三个速剪镜头是平底无暗角的 UI 截图，没有"同一台摄影机"的统一镜头质感
黑场后硬跳到大面积平灰底，开场字卡只有一行 Helvetica 回退字体的 "THE LAUNCH"，像占位
标题淡入微升 16f 后整整 91f 毫无变化，像一张静态海报
changes: 补 TRAILER_BUMPER_DURATION = 140；0/9/18 三连 9f 速剪、1→1.04 镜内推近、27–33f 纯黑空帧、33f 起 16f 淡入 + 44px out-cubic 微升全部保留
镜头 3 改为对焦中列 Top pages 卡、CSS zoom 2.2x 布局级放大，/changelog 等行字边锐利
三镜统一叠 0.18 镜头暗角 + 5% 颗粒
开场字卡改成品级：底色从黑场 12f 亮起到柔光底，34px 强调色眉题 + 176px 800 字重主标题 + 40px 副题，错峰 2f/6f 跟进
主标题字距 30f 内由 0.05em 缓收到 −0.012em（预告片标题的呼吸），63f 后整帧冻结真静止 77f
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench rendered the default 150f
Shot 3's 2.2x close-up used transform scale and was aimed between two cards, leaving text sharpness to compositor upscaling
The three quick cuts were flat UI screenshots with no vignette, nothing tying them to one camera
After the black beat it hard-jumped to a flat grey field with a single Helvetica-fallback line "THE LAUNCH" that looked like a placeholder
After the 16f fade-and-rise the title sat unchanged for 91f like a static poster
changesEn: Added TRAILER_BUMPER_DURATION = 140; the 0/9/18 trio of 9f cuts, 1→1.04 in-shot push, the pure black 27–33f gap and the 16f fade with 44px out-cubic rise from 33f are unchanged
Shot 3 now focuses on the centre-column Top pages card with a 2.2x CSS zoom, so the /changelog rows stay crisp
All three cuts share a 0.18 lens vignette and 5% grain
The opening card is now a finished title: the ground lights up from black over 12f into a soft backdrop, with a 34px accent eyebrow, 176px/800 main title and 40px subtitle staggered 2f/6f
The main title's tracking eases from 0.05em to −0.012em over 30f (the trailer title 'breath'), then from 63f the frame freezes for a true 77f hold
